sections.title: Item 1. Business
sections.content:
ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. Google segments include Google Services and Google Cloud.

sections.title: Item 7. MD&A
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

Google Cloud demonstrated strong operating leverage, achieving operating income of $1,716 million in 2023 compared to an operating loss of $(1,864) million in 2022.

sections.title: Item 8. Financial Statements
